purpose: Floor perspective plate for the scroll-driven walk
prompt:
An abstract stage-lighting texture. Narrow beams of warm amber light (#F5A524, #FFC15C) cutting at a shallow angle through dark theatrical haze against a deep blue-black ground (#070A12). Volumetric shafts with soft falloff, dust motes catching the light, gentle chromatic bloom at the beam edges. A faint deep crimson (#8B1E3F) undertone in the darkest regions suggesting curtain velvet without depicting fabric. Even distribution across the frame with no single dominant focal point. Restrained, elegant, cinematic. Purely abstract light and atmosphere.

An empty wooden stage floor receding into darkness, seen from low and close. Worn boards running away from the viewer toward a vanishing point, lit by a single warm amber source from the upper right so the grain catches the light in the foreground and falls to black at the horizon. Heavy haze above the boards. No people, no words, no logos, no furniture.

ee1.rationale: The strongest asset in the set and the only one that depicts what its purpose claims: a scuffed wooden stage floor lit from house right, through haze, with no people. It answers ACT II of the direction almost exactly. Not adopted in EE1 because doing so is a redesign of The Walk, which currently renders as a deliberate hairline-and-dot abstraction that also carries the reduced-motion and low-capability cut. Blocked on three things, in order: owner approval (approvalStatus is still pending-review), an optimised derivative, and an explicit decision to move The Walk from abstraction to photography.
